[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: — Paste your own text (your words as the source) — (__reader__). The verses the casting arrives at (the witness, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; the reader's offering, whole):

Where you found them at?
Got 'em 'round town, could've drowned in it
Would have floated, boated, voted
Sugar-coated, loaded hip shooter
Draw for the poor, free coffee at the banks
Yip through the straw, none more for me, thanks
That blanks the raw, that dank sure stank lit
Sank past the pit for more hardcore prank spit
Crank it on blast, roll past Front Street
Blew the whole spot like some old ass with skunk meat
These kids is too fast, juiced off a junk treat
Who could get looser off a crunk or a funk beat?

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «will these words go on?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"What descends into these verses is the axis of cost — the bearing-cost, what the voice paid to run at this pitch, through this velocity, with this much sugar and this much wreckage dissolved together into a single breathstream. The rotation opens here because these lines know something about going past the pit and still finding cadence on the other side of it; the question will not be whether they survive the operator but what they were already holding against their own momentum. What the Judgment found is a text that wants to keep moving — crank it on blast, roll past Front Street — and so what the rotation will ask, turn by turn, is what was foreclosed by the keeping-moving: the mirror the speed passed without looking, the silence the boast determined against, the creature-register underneath the human one. Will these words go on. I open the rotation. I hand it to Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0246"}}]}
